title.narrative: Education for All Fast Track Initiative (EFAFTI) Catalytic Trust Fund

description.narrative:
"To help acceleration of progress towards Universal Primary Completion in countries with credible plans through a mixture of policy reform, increased resource mobilization (both domestic and external) and greater donor harmonization. The key developmental objectives are
Increase in universal primary completion rates in FTI countries Improved policies for education sector Increased donor harmonization Increased transparency and predictability of aid flows."
